did.description: DID of the repository owner. A knot without the repo-did-input capability reads this and name in place of repo.

name.description: Name of the repository to delete. A knot without the repo-did-input capability reads this and DID in place of repo.

repo.description: DID of the repository to delete

rkey.description: Rkey of the repository record. A knot without the repo-did-input capability checks this against the owner's PDS.

force.description: Admin-only. Delete even though the repository record still exists on the owner's PDS.
